name: Ryoujoku Kangofu ~Jigoku Seme~
source:
Main character is a former doctor who works for a medical-related foundation. He's in charge of a special medical ward where powerful people hide from the media attention or law enforcement authorities. What they need is good service, not a good doctor. So protagonist trains special medical stuff to satisfy any customer needs.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名前医生，如今为一家医疗相关基金会工作。他负责一间特殊医疗病房，权势人物在此躲避媒体与执法机关的关注。他们需要的是良好服务，而非好医生。于是主人公培训特殊医护人员，满足顾客的任何需求。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
